narrative.intro: Orano Federal Services has $900M in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Orano Federal Services recorded 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $450M and year-over-year change up 179868.7%. Orano Federal Services obligations were much smaller in prior years: FY21 $251K, FY22 $1.5M, FY23 $655K, and FY25 $500K. Orano Federal Services shows a large concentration of obligations in FY26 when Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing accounts for $900M in obligations. Current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the figures shown are contract obligations except where tables list total contract values. Orano Federal Services exhibits a shift from modest year-to-year obligations in earlier fiscal years to the sizable FY26 obligations, and the average award size this year is large relative to the earlier single-year figures listed here.
